exact key/body/revision replay、CAS、unknown response；不用new key重做
兩個listener身份不同；Python私有credential、BFF actor stripping、TLS驗證
claim-only、同key衝突、source/scope/session/epoch失效重讀，不創造trusted ack

hash/framing/fsync/同filesystem atomic rename；stage非published、衝突不覆寫
